task_description: Call OpenAI API with a very long document
failure_reason: Input exceeded model context window limit
lesson: Always check token count before sending to LLM API
suggested_approach: Chunk the document and process in batches, or summarize first

task_description: Connect to third-party API with missing bearer token
failure_reason: Authorization header was not included in request
lesson: Validate auth configuration at startup before first request
suggested_approach: Use config validation and fail fast with explicit diagnostics

task_description: Execute API batch calls under high load
failure_reason: Burst traffic triggered 429 responses due to missing backoff
lesson: API integrations require adaptive retry and jitter
suggested_approach: Implement exponential backoff with random jitter and circuit breaker
